description: Knowledge wires written from a source passage (ingestion): each item is one wire with its quote; the context is the passage.

defaults._note: calibration-v1 (2026-10-02, 30 items, 10 planted): v4-flash reasoning low found 10/10 with 0/20 false alarms; v4-flash without reasoning 7/10 (missed hedges and a unit error), v4.1-flash without reasoning 9/10 with 2/20 false alarms. Reasoning needs small batches and a large max_tokens (one 18-item batch overflowed 8000 tokens).
